theorems.name: Submission.lpf_wtc_lusin_compact_pieces
theorems.statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (V M : Set (Eucl Q)) (θ : Eucl Q → ℝ), IsOpen V → M ⊆ V → NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) → (∀ y ∈ M, 0 < θ y) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl Q), IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q))) → ∃ C : ℕ → Set (Eucl Q), (∀ k, IsCompact (C k)) ∧ (∀ k, C k ⊆ M) ∧ (∀ k, ContinuousOn θ (C k)) ∧ (∀ k, (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) (C k) < ∞) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) (M \ ⋃ k, C k) = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
